scientific_integrity: The archival focal source is Henry--Roscilde (first public 2013-07-26), which defines square-only plaquette quantum ice on a planar checkerboard lattice; the 2024 Sivaramakrishnan--Ganesh paper provides the curved cuboctahedral geometry and its previously known 600 ice states and per-square 192 flippable marginal, explicitly credited. The assessed claim is the complete cuboctahedral six-square joint-flippability and sector census together with its exactly derived weighted quantum spectra. All local enumerations exhaustive and independently replayed; no independent validation asserted.
scientific_limitations: Exact finite 12-vertex cuboctahedral Eulerian-orientation model only; square-face reversals only, triangles suppressed; spectral gap/unique ground state for strictly positive real face amplitudes. No larger-graph asymptotic, noise, experimental-realization or global priority claim.
title: Square-only cuboctahedral ice: complete kinetic fragmentation and weighted spectrum
